full_prompt_en: A square hand-colored satirical engraving shows a crowded street celebration framed by old stone buildings and distant towers. At the far left, a rough brick wall and a raised stone edge hold several onlookers. In front of them, a man in a red coat and tall brown hat strides across the cobbles with bent knees and lifted arms. Beside him, a woman in a white dress with rose-colored overskirt turns toward him, her pale skirt sweeping into the center. Another man near the middle leaps or dances forward in dark clothes, one leg extended and both arms spread wide. Around them, tightly packed men and women raise hands, lean together and react to the commotion. Pink, blue and gray dresses punctuate the mostly earth-colored crowd on the right. The ground is irregular stone and dirt, with a narrow dark gap or trench cutting across the lower middle and small scattered objects near the right edge. Behind the people, steep rooflines and a row of pointed city towers fade into a light gray sky. Fine brown-black etched lines build faces, clothing folds, masonry and distant architecture; thin watercolor-like washes add red, pink, yellow and blue without covering the printed linework. Soft daylight illuminates the busy street evenly, while deeper hatching collects under hats, feet and eaves. The overall composition moves in a lively diagonal from the red figure to the dancing center and gathered crowd, making the historical-looking scene witty and animated.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形手工设色讽刺版画里，一场拥挤的街头庆祝被旧石建筑与远处塔楼围住。最左侧，粗石墙和抬高的石沿承托几位旁观者。前方，一个穿红外套、戴高褐帽的男子屈膝跨过石板，双臂举起。他旁边，一位穿白裙与玫瑰色罩裙的女子朝他转身，浅色裙摆扫向中央。中央附近另一名深衣男子向前跃起或起舞，一腿伸出，双臂张开。周围紧挤的男女举手、相互倾身，对热闹场面作出反应。粉、蓝、灰色裙装点在右侧总体土色的人群中。地面是不规则石块和泥土，一道窄深沟或裂口横切下方中部，右缘附近散着一些小物件。人群后方，陡斜屋顶与一排尖城市塔楼渐入浅灰天空。纤细棕黑蚀刻线构成脸、衣褶、砌体与远处建筑；薄水彩式色层添上红、粉、黄、蓝，却没有遮住印刷线条。柔和日光均匀照亮繁忙街道，较深排线积在帽檐、脚下与屋檐下。整体构图从红衣人物斜向跳舞的中心和聚拢的人群流动，使这幅旧时场景机智而生动。
style_prompt_en: The hand-colored engraving relies on fine brown-black etched contours and close hatching beneath thin, imperfect color washes. Cream paper stays visible between many marks, giving crowded detail a light, archival ground. Earth browns and grays carry the largest areas, while small red, pink, blue and yellow patches pull the eye through the image. Forms are animated by brisk angled lines and compressed overlaps; darker hatch density supplies shadow rather than smooth tonal gradients. Diffuse daylight keeps the overall surface readable even in busy passages. The composition feels theatrical and satirical, with abundant miniature incidents held together by rhythmic gestures and a lively diagonal flow.
style_prompt_zh: 这种手工设色版画依靠纤细棕黑蚀刻轮廓与密排线，底上覆盖薄而不完美的色洗。奶油色纸在许多笔痕间露出，让拥挤细节仍有轻盈的档案底色。土褐与灰色承担最大区域，少量红、粉、蓝和黄斑块牵引视线穿过图像。快捷斜线和压紧重叠赋予形体动势；阴影由较密排线而非平滑调子产生。漫射日光使繁忙段落依然整体可读。构图带舞台性和讽刺性，许多微小事件由有节奏的动作和活跃斜向流动收拢。
theme_en: A lively crowd dancing and gesturing along an old cobbled street
theme_zh: 热闹人群在旧石板街上跳舞、挥手
name: Isaac Cruikshank
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
